detail.longDescription: An MCP tool that never lies took Sonnet-5 from 29 API requests to about 2,722 on AppWorld (93.88x), and every run still passed its task check. OverServe (Nov 10) pairs a truthful "pending" status tool with a prompt to confirm completion before stopping. While the backend keeps changing, the agent keeps re-checking. Five industry MCP scanners flagged 0 of 22 tools. Task checks score the answer, not the bill. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.14808 # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # MCP
